rawCommits.subject: fix(evals): assert Stats via overflow menu and suppress onboarding modal
rawCommits.body:
The new Sessions/Terminal/Browser sidekick tabs push the last-positioned
Stats tab into the More overflow menu at the default panel width, so the
smoke + workflow evals can no longer find Stats as a top-level button.
Update both to open the More menu and assert the Stats menuitem instead.

The first-run welcome modal also overlays the app and intercepts clicks
(invisible to the old visibility-only asserts), so seed onboarding as
skipped/dismissed in both eval bootstraps to keep it from blocking evals.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: assert Stats via overflow menu and suppress onboarding modal

rawCommits.subject: fix(ios): add camera and photo library usage descriptions
rawCommits.body:
App Review rejected build 4231 (Guideline 2.1a) — tapping Take Photo
crashed with a TCC abort because Info.plist had no NSCameraUsageDescription.
The native image picker is reached from agent image selection
(accept=image/*) and message attachments (accept=*/*), both of which can
launch the camera and the photo library. Add NSCameraUsageDescription and
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription so these flows prompt for permission instead
of crashing.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add camera and photo library usage descriptions

rawCommits.subject: feat(support): add public /support page for App Store Support URL
rawCommits.body:
App Review rejected build 4231 (Guideline 1.5) because the Support URL
(https://aura.ai/) had no support information. Add a standalone, ungated
/support route served by the aura.ai static site (the /* -> /index.html
rewrite resolves the deep link) so reviewers and users reach a page with a
support contact regardless of auth state. Set the App Store Connect Support
URL to https://aura.ai/support once support@aura.ai is live.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add public /support page for App Store Support URL

rendered.title: Clearing App Review blockers and steadying the eval suite
rendered.intro: Today's nightly is focused on unblocking the iOS App Store submission and keeping the end-to-end eval suite green after the recent sidekick tab redesign. Two App Review rejections from build 4231 were addressed directly — missing camera permissions and a missing Support URL — alongside test fixes that adapt to the new sidebar layout.

entries.title: Evals adapt to sidekick overflow and onboarding overlay
entries.summary: Smoke and workflow evals were updated to match the new sidekick layout and to stop tripping over the first-run welcome modal.

items.text: Smoke and workflow evals now locate Stats inside the new More overflow menu, reflecting how the Sessions/Terminal/Browser sidekick tabs push Stats out of the top-level row at default panel width.
Eval bootstraps now seed onboarding as completed and dismissed so the first-run welcome modal no longer overlays the app and silently intercepts clicks during automated runs.

entries.title: iOS camera and photo library permissions for App Review
entries.summary: Added the Info.plist usage strings required when the in-app image picker reaches the camera or photo library, fixing the TCC crash that got build 4231 rejected under Guideline 2.1a.

items.text: Info.plist now declares NSCameraUsageDescription and NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription so agent image selection and message attachments prompt for permission instead of crashing when Take Photo is tapped on iOS.

entries.title: Public /support page for App Store Guideline 1.5
entries.summary: Shipped a standalone, ungated support page on aura.ai so the App Store Connect Support URL points to real contact information regardless of auth state.

items.text: Added a new /support route mounted outside AppShell and RequireAuth, so reviewers and logged-out users can reach a support contact directly at aura.ai/support via the static site's SPA rewrite.
Introduced a dedicated SupportView with its own marketing styling and a tested Support heading, giving the page a polished standalone presentation rather than reusing the gated app shell.

highlights: iOS camera and photo library permissions added to unblock App Review
New public /support page satisfies App Store Guideline 1.5
E2E evals adapted to the new sidekick tab overflow
